ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 13

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

10. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 7

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 22

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 42
   D. 90

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

18. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 1

19. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

21. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

24. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
